comparison.title: Why Choose Archeris.net?
comparison.subtitle: How we compare with traditional solutions like Ianseo
comparison.description: Archeris is built from the ground up to modernize tournament management and scoring, bringing a modern cloud-native approach to archery tournaments.
comparison.f1_archeris: 100% Cloud-Native. Instant access via Web & Mobile without local servers or software installation.
comparison.f1_ianseo: Offline desktop application. Requires local MySQL database, Apache, and complex network setup.
comparison.f2_archeris: Dedicated mobile scorekeeper app. Instant real-time score sync per arrow on the field.
comparison.f2_ianseo: Conventional scoring via laptop terminals or manual papers with complex local bridging.
comparison.f3_archeris: Real-time online public leaderboard viewable by athletes, coaches, and spectators worldwide.
comparison.f3_ianseo: Limited to on-site TV screens or delayed manual file export and static web uploads.
comparison.f4_archeris: Automated seeding and match tree progressions generated instantly following official World Archery rules.
comparison.f4_ianseo: Multi-step manual bracket calculation and configuration prone to human calculation errors.
comparison.f5_archeris: Integrated online athlete registration with automated payment gateways (QRIS, VA, Cards, E-Wallets).
comparison.f5_ianseo: No built-in payment gateway. Relies on external spreadsheets and manual bank transfer verification.
comparison.f6_archeris: Automated session and target butt distribution with interactive visual target map drag-and-drop.
comparison.f6_ianseo: Static tabular target assignment requiring manual adjustments and static printouts.
comparison.f7_archeris: One-click QR-verified certificates, athlete analytics, and official PDF result booklets.
comparison.f7_ianseo: Standard rigid printouts requiring manual document compilation and separate print runs.

comparison_page.blog_title: The Evolution of Archery Tournament Management: Why Switch to Archeris.net?
comparison_page.blog_p1: For over a decade, Ianseo has been a standard software widely used in archery tournaments worldwide. Designed as an offline/desktop application (PHP/MySQL), Ianseo has strong technical capabilities for standard World Archery formats. However, with rapid mobile and cloud technology advances, modern organizer and archer requirements have shifted significantly.
comparison_page.blog_p2: Archeris.net is a modern tournament management platform designed cloud-native from day one. Unlike legacy desktop systems requiring complex local server setups, independent database installations, and wired LAN cables between laptops, Archeris.net enables the entire workflow—from online registration, automated QRIS/Virtual Account payments, target lane allocation, to real-time live scoring via mobile tablets—accessible from any browser.

faqs_list.question: How does the Standard EO 3-month free promo work?
faqs_list.answer: During the initial 3-month promotional period, organizers can register and claim Standard EO tournament quota completely free ($0.00) with no upfront or hidden fees to publish and manage tournaments.

faqs_list.question: What happens after the 3-month promo period ends?
faqs_list.answer: All existing tournaments and past tournament data remain permanently active. For publishing new future tournaments after the promo ends, Standard EO quota is available at the normal flat rate of $3.00 per tournament.

faqs_list.question: Do purchased tournament quotas have an expiration date?
faqs_list.answer: No. All tournament quotas stored in your organizer account never expire. You can keep them and use them whenever your tournament schedule is set.

faqs_list.question: When is tournament quota deducted from my account balance?
faqs_list.answer: Tournament quota is only deducted when you publish an tournament (changing status from Draft to Public). While setting up categories, brackets, and rules in Draft mode, no quota is consumed.

faqs_list.question: Can I purchase custom numbers of tournament slots?
faqs_list.answer: Yes! In your organizer dashboard, you can enter any custom number of tournament slots you require to plan out your organization's yearly calendar.

items.question: How do I register an organizer on Archeris.net?
items.answer: You can register your organizer via the registration page by choosing the "Organizer" account type. Once your email is verified, you can complete your organizer profile and start managing tournaments.

items.question: Can the scoring system be used for offline tournaments?
items.answer: Absolutely! Archeris.net is designed to simplify offline tournament scoring digitally. Scores can be entered directly by referees or participants through the application.

items.question: How does the tournament registration payment process work?
items.answer: We support various automated payment methods such as Bank Transfer, E-Wallet, and QRIS. Registration status is updated automatically upon successful payment.

items.question: Is athlete data kept secure?
items.answer: We implement strict data security standards and end-to-end encryption to ensure all athletes' personal information is stored securely.

items.question: How do I request technical assistance?
items.answer: If you encounter any technical issues, please contact our support team through the Contact page or send an email to support{'@'}archeris.net.
